title: Seed replay: a dataset of an object walled by a declared tenantField throws INVALID_FILTER (existing rows filtered on organization_id)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cw787kMeaX7oyz7DDC

Found while fixing #33393 (PR #33409), measured on its branch at `99f60e1df` with a temporary test case (real AppPlugin + SqlDriver over better-sqlite3), then removed.

## Line

A seed dataset OF an object walled by a declared `tenancy.tenantField` with `systemFields.tenant: false` (e.g. `{ object: 'crm_workspace_tag', mode: 'upsert', externalId: 'name', records: [{ name: 'Silver' }] }`) · AppPlugin's per-organization seed replayer on a walled boot · rare (custom tenant field) · measured.

`replayer(ORG_NORTH)` throws the driver's INVALID_FILTER ("A filter on object crm_workspace_tag names a column the database could not resolve"). Cause: `SeedLoaderService.loadExistingRecords` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`, the per-tenant replay branch) filters the SOURCE object's existing rows by `where.organization_id`, the hard-coded column #33393 fixed on the reference-target side.

## Not a mechanical fix

The loader also has to decide what it stamps on such rows: `seedRowNeedsOrganization` answers only for `organization_id`. So the fix needs (a) the existing-rows filter on the resolved tenant column, and (b) a rule for stamping the declared tenant column on seeded rows (or refusing such a dataset with a named error instead of a driver refusal).

Reader who acts: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` (`loadExistingRecords`, `seedRowNeedsOrganization`), `packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`.
Suggested grade: p3. Lane: `domain:server`.
